-- Change: ATOMIC-001
-- Purpose: Canonical logical envelope for atomic facts (TELCHI spec §9/§10/§43).
-- This file is a CONTRACT document, not an executable query.
-- Physical mapping lives in the source_*_*.sql extractors.
-- Storage-independent: the model does not depend on parquet/postgres.

--                   CANDIDATE  = must be investigated.

-- ENVELOPE KEYS (logical) -> source (confirmed)
--   source_system            : 'SAP' | 'DMS' | 'RETAIL_ONE' (see U_* probes)

--   business_date            : OINV.DocDate (business)
--   posting_date             : OINV.TaxDate

--   currency / quantity / uom / amount_document / amount_local
--   status / cancelled      : DocStatus / CANCELED
-- =============================================================================

-- =============================================================================
-- ATOMIC RELATION — INVENTORY MOVEMENT -> SOURCE DOCUMENT (OINM -> OINV/ODLN)
-- =============================================================================
-- DOCUMENT_RELATION contract: from = commercial document (AR_INVOICE /
-- DELIVERY), to = INVENTORY_MOVEMENT, relation_type = GENERATES.
--
-- Resolution strategies (validated, never guessed):
--   A) OFFICIAL (ApplObj > 0): AppObjAbs = DocEntry, AppObjLine = LineNum
--      -> match_method = SAP_BASEENTRY, confidence 1.0.
--   B) DOCNUM_RESOLVE (ApplObj = -1): OINM.BASE_REF = DocNum (NOT DocEntry!)
--      -> header.DocEntry, then DocLineNum = LineNum and ItemCode match
--      -> match_method = DIRECT_REFERENCE; confidence 1.0 with line+item,
--         0.5 header-only.
-- DocNum collides across document families (collision_rate 1.0), so the
-- TransType family guard is MANDATORY (13=OINV, 15=ODLN).
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
    'AR_INVOICE'          AS "from_object_type",
    OINV."DocEntry"       AS "from_document_id",
    INV1."LineNum"        AS "from_line_id",
    'INVENTORY_MOVEMENT'  AS "to_object_type",
    OINM."TransNum"       AS "to_document_id",
    'GENERATES'           AS "relation_type",
    'DIRECT_REFERENCE'    AS "match_method",
    CASE WHEN INV1."LineNum" = OINM."DocLineNum" AND INV1."ItemCode" = OINM."ItemCode"
         THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.5 END AS "confidence",
    OINM."TransType"      AS "trans_type",
    OINM."BASE_REF"       AS "base_ref",
    OINM."DocLineNum"     AS "movement_line",
    OINM."ItemCode"       AS "item_id",
    OINM."DocDate"        AS "event_at",
    OINM."InQty"          AS "in_qty",
    OINM."OutQty"         AS "out_qty",
    OINM."Warehouse"      AS "warehouse_id",
    'DOCNUM_RESOLVE'      AS "strategy"
FROM TELCHI.OINM AS OINM
LEFT JOIN TELCHI.OINV AS OINV
    ON OINV."DocNum" = OINM."BASE_REF"
LEFT JOIN TELCHI.INV1 AS INV1
    ON INV1."DocEntry" = OINV."DocEntry"
   AND INV1."LineNum" = OINM."DocLineNum"
WHERE OINM."TransType" = 13
  AND OINM."ApplObj" <= 0
  AND OINM."DocDate" >= :start_date || ' 00:00:00'
  AND OINM."DocDate" <= :end_date || ' 23:59:59'

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'DELIVERY'            AS "from_object_type",
    ODLN."DocEntry"       AS "from_document_id",
    DLN1."LineNum"        AS "from_line_id",
    'INVENTORY_MOVEMENT'  AS "to_object_type",
    OINM."TransNum"       AS "to_document_id",
    'GENERATES'           AS "relation_type",
    'DIRECT_REFERENCE'    AS "match_method",
    CASE WHEN DLN1."LineNum" = OINM."DocLineNum" AND DLN1."ItemCode" = OINM."ItemCode"
         THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.5 END AS "confidence",
    OINM."TransType"      AS "trans_type",
    OINM."BASE_REF"       AS "base_ref",
    OINM."DocLineNum"     AS "movement_line",
    OINM."ItemCode"       AS "item_id",
    OINM."DocDate"        AS "event_at",
    OINM."InQty"          AS "in_qty",
    OINM."OutQty"         AS "out_qty",
    OINM."Warehouse"      AS "warehouse_id",
    'DOCNUM_RESOLVE'      AS "strategy"
FROM TELCHI.OINM AS OINM
LEFT JOIN TELCHI.ODLN AS ODLN
    ON ODLN."DocNum" = OINM."BASE_REF"
LEFT JOIN TELCHI.DLN1 AS DLN1
    ON DLN1."DocEntry" = ODLN."DocEntry"
   AND DLN1."LineNum" = OINM."DocLineNum"
WHERE OINM."TransType" = 15
  AND OINM."ApplObj" <= 0
  AND OINM."DocDate" >= :start_date || ' 00:00:00'
  AND OINM."DocDate" <= :end_date || ' 23:59:59'

UNION ALL

SELECT
    CASE OINM."TransType"
        WHEN 59 THEN 'PRODUCTION'
        WHEN 60 THEN 'PRODUCTION'
        ELSE CONCAT('OBJTYPE_', TO_NVARCHAR(OINM."TransType"))
    END                   AS "from_object_type",
    OINM."AppObjAbs"      AS "from_document_id",
    OINM."AppObjLine"     AS "from_line_id",
    'INVENTORY_MOVEMENT'  AS "to_object_type",
    OINM."TransNum"       AS "to_document_id",
    'GENERATES'           AS "relation_type",
    'SAP_BASEENTRY'       AS "match_method",
    1.0                   AS "confidence",
    OINM."TransType"      AS "trans_type",
    OINM."BASE_REF"       AS "base_ref",
    OINM."DocLineNum"     AS "movement_line",
    OINM."ItemCode"       AS "item_id",
    OINM."DocDate"        AS "event_at",
    OINM."InQty"          AS "in_qty",
    OINM."OutQty"         AS "out_qty",
    OINM."Warehouse"      AS "warehouse_id",
    'APPLOBJ_OFFICIAL'    AS "strategy"
FROM TELCHI.OINM AS OINM
WHERE OINM."ApplObj" > 0
  AND OINM."DocDate" >= :start_date || ' 00:00:00'
  AND OINM."DocDate" <= :end_date || ' 23:59:59'
) AS R
-- =============================================================================
-- gate: ATOMIC-003 (P0 stock -> document relation)
-- =============================================================================
joins:
JOIN TELCHI.OINV AS OINV
    ON OINV."DocNum" = OINM."BASE_REF"
 | JOIN TELCHI.INV1 AS INV1
    ON INV1."DocEntry" = OINV."DocEntry"
   AND INV1."LineNum" = OINM."DocLineNum"
 | JOIN TELCHI.ODLN AS ODLN
    ON ODLN."DocNum" = OINM."BASE_REF"
 | JOIN TELCHI.DLN1 AS DLN1
    ON DLN1."DocEntry" = ODLN."DocEntry"
   AND DLN1."LineNum" = OINM."DocLineNum"

OINM."TransType" = 13
  AND OINM."ApplObj" <= 0
  AND OINM."DocDate" >= :start_date || ' 00:00:00'
  AND OINM."DocDate" <= :end_date || ' 23:59:59'

-- =============================================================================
-- CANCELLATION AUDIT 01: TOTAL UNIVERSE OF CANCELLED INVOICES
-- =============================================================================
-- Purpose: Determine the complete universe of cancelled invoices
-- Grain: OINV.DocEntry (one row per invoice)
-- =============================================================================

WITH cancellation_derivation AS (
    SELECT
        OINV."DocEntry",
        OINV."DocNum",
        OINV."CardCode",
        OINV."CardName",
        OINV."SlpCode",
        OINV."DocDate",
        OINV."DocDueDate",
        OINV."DocTotal",
        OINV."DocStatus",
        OINV."CANCELED",
        OINV."DocSubType",
        OINV."TransId",
        OINV."PaidSum",
        OINV."PaidToDate",
        OINV."DocCur",
        OINV."UpdateDate",
        OINV."UpdateTS",

        -- Cancellation derivation
        CASE
            WHEN OINV."CANCELED" = 'Y' THEN OINV."UpdateDate"
            ELSE NULL
        END AS "CancellationDate",

        CASE
            WHEN OINV."CANCELED" = 'Y'
            THEN DAYS_BETWEEN(OINV."DocDate", OINV."UpdateDate")
            ELSE NULL
        END AS "DaysToCancellation"

    FROM TELCHI."OINV" AS OINV
)
SELECT
    -- Universe totals
    COUNT(*) AS "TotalInvoices",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "CANCELED" = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "ActiveInvoices",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "CANCELED" = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "CanceledOriginal",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "CANCELED" = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "CanceledReversal",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "CANCELED" IN ('Y', 'C') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "TotalCanceled",

    -- Amount totals
    SUM("DocTotal") AS "TotalDocTotal",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "CANCELED" = 'N' THEN "DocTotal" ELSE 0 END) AS "ActiveDocTotal",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "CANCELED" = 'Y' THEN "DocTotal" ELSE 0 END) AS "CanceledDocTotal",

    -- Cancellation rate
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN "CANCELED" IN ('Y', 'C') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS "CancellationRatePct",
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN "CANCELED" = 'Y' THEN "DocTotal" ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM("DocTotal"), 4) AS "MonetaryCancellationRatePct"

FROM cancellation_derivation;
metrics: COUNT(*) | SUM(CASE WHEN "CANCELED" = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) | SUM(CASE WHEN "CANCELED" = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) | SUM(CASE WHEN "CANCELED" = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) | SUM(CASE WHEN "CANCELED" IN ('Y', 'C') | SUM("DocTotal") | SUM(CASE WHEN "CANCELED" = 'N' THEN "DocTotal" ELSE 0 END) | SUM(CASE WHEN "CANCELED" = 'Y' THEN "DocTotal" ELSE 0 END) | SUM(CASE WHEN "CANCELED" IN ('Y', 'C') | COUNT(*) | SUM(CASE WHEN "CANCELED" = 'Y' THEN "DocTotal" ELSE 0 END) | SUM("DocTotal")

-- CANCELLATION AUDIT 09: HIGH PRIORITY CASES
-- =============================================================================
-- Purpose: Identify cases requiring manual investigation
-- Grain: OINV.DocEntry (one row per cancelled invoice)
-- Priority: >30 days + high amount + delivery + payment
-- =============================================================================

WITH cancellation_derivation AS (
    SELECT
        OINV."DocEntry",
        OINV."DocNum",
        OINV."CardCode",
        OINV."CardName",
        OINV."SlpCode",
        (SELECT OSLP."SlpName" FROM TELCHI.OSLP AS OSLP WHERE OINV."SlpCode" = OSLP."SlpCode") AS "SellerName",
        OINV."DocDate",
        OINV."DocTotal",
        OINV."CANCELED",
        OINV."PaidToDate",
        OINV."UpdateDate" AS "CancellationDate",
        OINV."UpdateTS" AS "CancellationTimestamp",
        DAYS_BETWEEN(OINV."DocDate", OINV."UpdateDate") AS "DaysToCancellation"
    FROM TELCHI."OINV" AS OINV
    WHERE OINV."CANCELED" = 'Y'
),
-- Find reversal documents
reversal_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        Y."DocEntry" AS "OriginalDocEntry",
        C."DocEntry" AS "ReversalDocEntry",
        C."DocNum" AS "ReversalDocNum"
    FROM TELCHI."OINV" AS Y
    INNER JOIN TELCHI."OINV" AS C
        ON Y."CardCode" = C."CardCode"
        AND Y."DocTotal" = C."DocTotal"
        AND C."CANCELED" = 'C'
        AND ABS(DAYS_BETWEEN(Y."UpdateDate", C."DocDate")) <= 7
    WHERE Y."CANCELED" = 'Y'
),
-- Check for deliveries
delivery_check AS (
    SELECT
        CD."DocEntry",
        (SELECT COUNT(*)
         FROM TELCHI."INV1" AS INV1
         WHERE INV1."DocEntry" = CD."DocEntry"
           AND INV1."BaseEntry" IS NOT NULL
           AND INV1."BaseType" = 15) AS "DeliveryLineCount"
    FROM cancellation_derivation AS CD
),
-- Check for payments
payment_check AS (
    SELECT
        CD."DocEntry",
        COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ABS(ITR1."ReconSum"))
         FROM TELCHI."ITR1" AS ITR1
         INNER JOIN TELCHI."OITR" AS OITR ON ITR1."ReconNum" = OITR."ReconNum"
         WHERE ITR1."SrcObjAbs" = CD."DocEntry"
           AND ITR1."SrcObjTyp" = 13
           AND OITR."Canceled" = 'N'), 0) AS "ActivePaymentAmount"
    FROM cancellation_derivation AS CD
),
-- Calculate priority score
priority_cases AS (
    SELECT
        CD.*,
        RP."ReversalDocEntry",
        RP."ReversalDocNum",
        DC."DeliveryLineCount",
        PC."ActivePaymentAmount",

        -- Priority scoring
        (CASE WHEN CD."DaysToCancellation" > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN CD."DocTotal" > 10000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN DC."DeliveryLineCount" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
         CASE WHEN PC."ActivePaymentAmount" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "PriorityScore"

    FROM cancellation_derivation AS CD
    LEFT JOIN reversal_pairs AS RP ON CD."DocEntry" = RP."OriginalDocEntry"
    LEFT JOIN delivery_check AS DC ON CD."DocEntry" = DC."DocEntry"
    LEFT JOIN payment_check AS PC ON CD."DocEntry" = PC."DocEntry"
)
SELECT

    "DocNum",
    "CardCode",
    "CardName",
    "SlpCode",
    "SellerName",
    "DocDate",
    "CancellationDate",
    "DaysToCancellation",
    "DocTotal",
    "PaidToDate",
    "ReversalDocEntry",
    "ReversalDocNum",
    "DeliveryLineCount",
    "ActivePaymentAmount",
    "PriorityScore",

    -- Classification
    CASE
        WHEN "DaysToCancellation" > 30 AND "DeliveryLineCount" > 0 AND "ActivePaymentAmount" > 0
            THEN 'CRITICAL'
        WHEN "DaysToCancellation" > 30 AND "DeliveryLineCount" > 0
            THEN 'HIGH_STOCK'
        WHEN "DaysToCancellation" > 30 AND "ActivePaymentAmount" > 0
            THEN 'HIGH_PAYMENT'
        WHEN "DaysToCancellation" > 30
            THEN 'HIGH_DELAY'
        WHEN "DocTotal" > 10000
            THEN 'HIGH_VALUE'
        ELSE 'STANDARD'
    END AS "PriorityClass"

FROM priority_cases
WHERE "PriorityScore" >= 2

-- =============================================================================

-- =============================================================================
-- Change: TELCHI-COV-003

--   (OPOR.CANCELED='N' AND OPOR.DocStatus='O'), doc-linked via BaseEntry ->
--   DocEntry (Gate 1). Confidence = DOCUMENTED_ORDER; no physical arrival date
--   is asserted (IN_TRANSIT_UNRESOLVED). Kept OUT of temporal availability in
--   the conservative coverage run.

    O."DocNum"      AS po_docnum,
    O."DocDate"     AS po_docdate,
    O."CardCode",
    O."CardName",
    O."DocCur",
    O."U_TIPOCOMPRA",
    P."LineNum"     AS po_line,
    P."ItemCode",
    P."Quantity"    AS ordered_qty,
    P."OpenQty"     AS open_qty,
    P."WhsCode"
FROM TELCHI."OPOR" O
JOIN TELCHI."POR1" P ON P."DocEntry" = O."DocEntry"
WHERE O."CANCELED" = 'N' AND O."DocStatus" = 'O' AND P."OpenQty" > 0

-- =============================================================================
-- OPEN PURCHASE vs OITW.ONORDER RECONCILIATION — TELCHI_EQUIVALENT_MATERIAL_COVERAGE_V1
-- =============================================================================
-- Change: TELCHI-COV-004
-- Grain: ItemCode (items with an open PO line)
-- READ ONLY.
-- =============================================================================
-- Anti-double-count reconciliation (P0.2). Two representations of "ordered but
-- not received" must NOT be summed:
--   OPEN_PURCHASE_QTY = SUM(POR1.OpenQty) over open POs (purchase UOM, doc-linked)
--   ONORDER_QTY       = SUM(OITW.OnOrder) (inventory UOM, system aggregate)
-- They diverge for two documented reasons:
--   (1) UOM conversion (purchase UOM != inventory UOM on traded/packaged items);
--   (2) OITW.OnOrder includes sources beyond open POs (e.g. partially-received
--       POs still flagged on-order, and production/transfer commitments).
-- Canonical documentary future order quantity = OPEN_PURCHASE_QTY (line-level,
-- supplier/date/tipo-linked). ONORDER_QTY is the reconciliation check only.
-- =============================================================================
SELECT
    P."ItemCode",
    SUM(P."OpenQty") AS "OpenPurchaseQty",
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(T."OnOrder") FROM TELCHI."OITW" T
              WHERE T."ItemCode" = P."ItemCode"), 0) AS "OnOrderQty"
FROM TELCHI."POR1" P
JOIN TELCHI."OPOR" O ON O."DocEntry" = P."DocEntry"
WHERE O."CANCELED" = 'N' AND O."DocStatus" = 'O' AND P."OpenQty" > 0
GROUP BY P."ItemCode"
ORDER BY P."ItemCode"

T."ItemCode" = P."ItemCode"), 0) AS "OnOrderQty"
FROM TELCHI."POR1" P
JOIN TELCHI."OPOR" O ON O."DocEntry" = P."DocEntry"
WHERE O."CANCELED" = 'N' AND O."DocStatus" = 'O' AND P."OpenQty" > 0

-- =============================================================================
-- CURRENT ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE — FINANCIAL-005
-- =============================================================================
-- Change ID: FINANCIAL-005
-- Motivation: Calculate current AR with aging by invoice.
--   Grain: OINV.DocEntry (one row per invoice)
--   AS_OF_DATE: latest ReconDate in OITR
-- =============================================================================
-- Logic:
--   1. Get all active invoices (CANCELED = 'N', DocStatus = 'O')
--   2. Calculate settlement from ITR1 (SrcObjTyp=13 ReconSum)
--   3. Calculate outstanding = DocTotal - Settlement
--   4. Calculate days overdue = AS_OF_DATE - DocDueDate
--   5. Assign aging bucket
--   6. Classify financial status
-- =============================================================================
-- Aging Buckets:
--   NOT_DUE: DocDueDate >= AS_OF_DATE
--   1-30: 0 < days_overdue <= 30
--   31-60: 30 < days_overdue <= 60
--   61-90: 60 < days_overdue <= 90
--   91-120: 90 < days_overdue <= 120
--   120+: days_overdue > 120
-- =============================================================================

WITH as_of AS (
    -- Get the latest reconciliation date as AS_OF_DATE
    SELECT MAX("ReconDate") AS "AS_OF_DATE"
    FROM TELCHI."OITR"
),
invoice_settlement AS (
    -- Calculate total settlement per invoice from all reconciliations
    SELECT
        I."SrcObjAbs" AS "InvoiceDocEntry",
        SUM(I."ReconSum") AS "TotalSettlement",
        COUNT(DISTINCT I."ReconNum") AS "ReconCount"
    FROM TELCHI."ITR1" AS I
    INNER JOIN TELCHI."OITR" AS O ON I."ReconNum" = O."ReconNum"
    WHERE I."SrcObjTyp" = 13  -- Invoice lines
      AND O."Canceled" = 'N'  -- Active reconciliations
    GROUP BY I."SrcObjAbs"
),
ar_calculation AS (
    -- Calculate outstanding and aging for each invoice
    SELECT
        OINV."DocEntry",
        OINV."DocNum",
        OINV."CardCode",
        OINV."SlpCode",
        OINV."DocDate",
        OINV."DocDueDate",
        OINV."DocTotal",
        OINV."DocCur",
        OINV."DocStatus",
        OINV."CANCELED",
        COALESCE(IS2."TotalSettlement", 0) AS "TotalSettlement",
        COALESCE(IS2."ReconCount", 0) AS "ReconCount",
        (OINV."DocTotal" - COALESCE(IS2."TotalSettlement", 0)) AS "Outstanding",
        CASE
            WHEN OINV."DocDueDate" >= (SELECT "AS_OF_DATE" FROM as_of) THEN 0
            ELSE DATEDIFF('DAY', OINV."DocDueDate", (SELECT "AS_OF_DATE" FROM as_of))
        END AS "DaysOverdue",
        (SELECT "AS_OF_DATE" FROM as_of) AS "AS_OF_DATE"
    FROM TELCHI."OINV"
    LEFT JOIN invoice_settlement AS IS2 ON OINV."DocEntry" = IS2."InvoiceDocEntry"
    WHERE OINV."CANCELED" = 'N'
      AND OINV."DocStatus" = 'O'
)
SELECT
    "DocEntry",
    "DocNum",
    "CardCode",
    "SlpCode",
    "DocDate",
    "DocDueDate",
    "DocTotal",
    "DocCur",
    "TotalSettlement",
    "ReconCount",
    "Outstanding",
    "DaysOverdue",
    "AS_OF_DATE",
    -- Aging bucket
    CASE
        WHEN "Outstanding" <= 0.01 THEN 'SETTLED'
        WHEN "DaysOverdue" = 0 THEN 'NOT_DUE'
        WHEN "DaysOverdue" <= 30 THEN '1-30'
        WHEN "DaysOverdue" <= 60 THEN '31-60'
        WHEN "DaysOverdue" <= 90 THEN '61-90'
        WHEN "DaysOverdue" <= 120 THEN '91-120'
        ELSE '120+'
    END AS "AgingBucket",
    -- Financial status
    CASE
        WHEN "Outstanding" <= -0.01 THEN 'CREDIT_BALANCE'
        WHEN "Outstanding" <= 0.01 THEN 'SETTLED'
        WHEN "DaysOverdue" = 0 THEN 'OPEN_NOT_DUE'
        ELSE 'OVERDUE'
    END AS "FinancialStatus",
    -- Simple status for reporting
    CASE
        WHEN "Outstanding" <= -0.01 THEN 'SALDO_A_FAVOR'
        WHEN "Outstanding" <= 0.01 THEN 'PAGADA'
        WHEN "DaysOverdue" = 0 THEN 'PENDIENTE'
        ELSE 'VENCIDA'
    END AS "SimpleStatus"
FROM ar_calculation
ORDER BY "Outstanding" DESC

-- =============================================================================
-- SETTLEMENT AGGREGATION BY INVOICE — FINANCIAL-005
-- =============================================================================
-- Change ID: FINANCIAL-005
-- Motivation: Build per-invoice settlement from reconciliation data.
--   Grain: OINV.DocEntry (one row per invoice)
--   Purpose: Calculate total settlement per invoice by component type
-- =============================================================================
-- Logic:
--   1. Find all invoices (SrcObjTyp=13) in ITR1
--   2. For each invoice's ReconNum, find all OTHER members
--   3. Classify other members by SrcObjTyp
--   4. Aggregate settlement amounts by invoice and type
-- =============================================================================
-- Settlement Components:
--   PaymentSettlement: SrcObjTyp IN (24, 46) — incoming payments
--   CreditSettlement: SrcObjTyp = 14 — A/R credit memos
--   DownPaymentSettlement: SrcObjTyp = 25 — down payments received
--   JournalSettlement: SrcObjTyp = 30 — journal entries
--   OtherSettlement: everything else
-- =============================================================================
-- Note: ReconSum sign indicates direction.
--   For invoices (SrcObjTyp=13): negative = settled, positive = unsettled
--   For payments (SrcObjTyp=24): positive = amount applied
--   We use ABS() for aggregation to get absolute settlement amounts.
-- =============================================================================

WITH invoice_recons AS (
    -- Step 1: Find all invoices in reconciliations
    SELECT
        I."SrcObjAbs" AS "InvoiceDocEntry",
        I."ReconNum",
        I."ReconSum" AS "InvoiceReconSum",
        I."IsCredit" AS "InvoiceIsCredit"
    FROM TELCHI."ITR1" AS I
    INNER JOIN TELCHI."OITR" AS O ON I."ReconNum" = O."ReconNum"
    WHERE I."SrcObjTyp" = 13  -- A/R Invoice
      AND O."Canceled" = 'N'  -- Only active reconciliations
),
settlement_members AS (
    -- Step 2: Find all non-invoice members in those reconciliations
    SELECT
        IR."InvoiceDocEntry",
        IR."ReconNum",
        I."SrcObjTyp",
        I."SrcObjAbs",
        I."ReconSum",
        I."ReconSumFC",
        I."ReconSumSC",
        I."IsCredit",
        I."ShortName",
        I."Account"
    FROM invoice_recons AS IR
    INNER JOIN TELCHI."ITR1" AS I ON IR."ReconNum" = I."ReconNum"
    WHERE I."SrcObjTyp" != 13  -- Exclude invoice lines (we want settlement)
),
classified_settlements AS (
    -- Step 3: Classify settlement types
    SELECT
        "InvoiceDocEntry",
        "ReconNum",
        "SrcObjTyp",
        "SrcObjAbs",
        "ReconSum",
        "ReconSumFC",
        "ReconSumSC",
        "IsCredit",
        "ShortName",
        "Account",
        CASE
            WHEN "SrcObjTyp" IN (24, 46) THEN 'PAYMENT'
            WHEN "SrcObjTyp" = 14 THEN 'CREDIT_NOTE'
            WHEN "SrcObjTyp" = 25 THEN 'DOWN_PAYMENT'
            WHEN "SrcObjTyp" = 30 THEN 'JOURNAL'
            ELSE 'OTHER'
        END AS "SettlementType"
    FROM settlement_members
)
-- Step 4: Aggregate by invoice and settlement type
SELECT
    "InvoiceDocEntry",
    "SettlementType",
    COUNT(DISTINCT "ReconNum") AS "ReconCount",
    COUNT(*) AS "LineCount",
    SUM(ABS("ReconSum")) AS "TotalSettlement",
    SUM(ABS("ReconSumFC")) AS "TotalSettlementFC",
    SUM(ABS("ReconSumSC")) AS "TotalSettlementSC"
FROM classified_settlements
GROUP BY "InvoiceDocEntry", "SettlementType"
ORDER BY "InvoiceDocEntry", "SettlementType"

I."SrcObjTyp" = 13  -- A/R Invoice

            WHEN "SrcObjTyp" = 30 THEN 'JOURNAL'

-- =============================================================================
-- PURCHASE LEAD TIME ATOMIC EVENT — TELCHI_PURCHASE_LEAD_TIME_V1
-- =============================================================================
-- Change: TELCHI-LT-001
-- Grain: one row per (PO line, receipt line) through the document chain.
-- READ ONLY.
-- =============================================================================
-- Document chain (invoice-first, validated in Gate 1):
--   PO line (POR1.DocEntry+LineNum) -> invoice line (PCH1.BaseType=22,
--   BaseEntry=POR1.DocEntry, BaseLine=POR1.LineNum) -> receipt line
--   (PDN1.BaseType=18, BaseEntry=OPCH.DocEntry, BaseLine=PCH1.LineNum).
--   Direct PO->receipt is marginal (PDN1.BaseType=22, 54 lines).
--   Linkage: PO->invoice 90,782/90,998 (99.8%); invoice->receipt 87,616/87,616
--   (100%). Receipts without PO lineage: 8 lines (excluded from lead time).
-- Order date = OPOR.DocDate (BACKDATED_PO anomaly: invoice can precede PO).
-- Receipt date = OPDN.DocDate. Canceled OPDN (C/Y) excluded.
-- =============================================================================
WITH po_lines AS (
    SELECT P."DocEntry" AS po_entry, P."LineNum" AS po_line, P."ItemCode",
           P."Quantity" AS ordered_qty, P."WhsCode" AS po_whs,
           O."DocDate" AS order_date, O."CardCode", O."CardName",
           O."U_TIPOCOMPRA", O."DocCur", O."DocStatus"
    FROM TELCHI."POR1" P
    JOIN TELCHI."OPOR" O ON O."DocEntry" = P."DocEntry"
    WHERE O."CANCELED" = 'N'
),
receipt_events AS (
    -- invoice-first chain: PO -> invoice -> receipt
    SELECT P."DocEntry" AS po_entry, P."LineNum" AS po_line,
           R."DocEntry" AS rec_entry, R."LineNum" AS rec_line,
           R."Quantity" AS rec_qty, D."DocDate" AS rec_date, R."WhsCode" AS rec_whs
    FROM TELCHI."POR1" P
    JOIN TELCHI."PCH1" I ON I."BaseType"=22 AND I."BaseEntry"=P."DocEntry" AND I."BaseLine"=P."LineNum"
    JOIN TELCHI."PDN1" R ON R."BaseType"=18 AND R."BaseEntry"=I."DocEntry" AND R."BaseLine"=I."LineNum"
    JOIN TELCHI."OPDN" D ON D."DocEntry" = R."DocEntry"
    WHERE D."CANCELED" = 'N'
    UNION ALL
    -- direct PO -> receipt (marginal)
    SELECT P."DocEntry", P."LineNum", R."DocEntry", R."LineNum",
           R."Quantity", D."DocDate", R."WhsCode"
    FROM TELCHI."POR1" P
    JOIN TELCHI."PDN1" R ON R."BaseType"=22 AND R."BaseEntry"=P."DocEntry" AND R."BaseLine"=P."LineNum"
    JOIN TELCHI."OPDN" D ON D."DocEntry" = R."DocEntry"
    WHERE D."CANCELED" = 'N'
)
SELECT
    L.po_entry, L.po_line, L."ItemCode", L.ordered_qty,
    L.order_date, L."CardCode", L."CardName", L."U_TIPOCOMPRA", L."DocCur", L."DocStatus",
    R.rec_entry, R.rec_line, R.rec_qty, R.rec_date, R.rec_whs
FROM po_lines L
LEFT JOIN receipt_events R ON R.po_entry = L.po_entry AND R.po_line = L.po_line

JOIN TELCHI."OPOR" O ON O."DocEntry" = P."DocEntry"
     | JOIN TELCHI."PCH1" I ON I."BaseType"=22 AND I."BaseEntry"=P."DocEntry" AND I."BaseLine"=P."LineNum"
     | JOIN TELCHI."PDN1" R ON R."BaseType"=18 AND R."BaseEntry"=I."DocEntry" AND R."BaseLine"=I."LineNum"
     | JOIN TELCHI."OPDN" D ON D."DocEntry" = R."DocEntry"
     | JOIN TELCHI."PDN1" R ON R."BaseType"=22 AND R."BaseEntry"=P."DocEntry" AND R."BaseLine"=P."LineNum"
     | JOIN TELCHI."OPDN" D ON D."DocEntry" = R."DocEntry"
     | JOIN receipt_events R ON R.po_entry = L.po_entry AND R.po_line = L.po_line

O."CANCELED" = 'N'

    H."DocEntry",
    H."DocNum",
    H."ObjType",
    H."CANCELED",
    H."DocStatus",
    H."DocDate",
    H."DocDueDate",
    H."CreateDate",
    H."CardCode",
    H."CardName",
    H."NumAtCard",
    H."DocCur",
    H."DocRate",
    H."DocTotal",

-- =============================================================================
-- PURCHASE DOCUMENT CHAIN — TELCHI_PURCHASE_DATA_DISCOVERY_V1
-- =============================================================================
-- Change: TELCHI-PURCHASE-008
-- Grain: one row per linked purchase line across OPOR -> OPCH -> OPDN
-- READ ONLY.
-- =============================================================================
-- Semantics discovered (2026-08-27):
--   Operative flow (dominant):
--     OPOR (PO) -> OPCH (AP invoice) -> OPDN (goods receipt)
--     PCH1.BaseType = 22, PCH1.BaseEntry = OPOR.DocEntry   (100% linked)
--     PDN1.BaseType = 18, PDN1.BaseEntry = OPCH.DocEntry   (100% linked)
--   Direct PO -> receipt path is marginal:
--     PDN1.BaseType = 22, PDN1.BaseEntry = OPOR.DocEntry   (100% linked)
--   SAP-canonical link is BaseEntry -> DocEntry (integer). Line tables also
--   expose BaseRef/BaseDocNum (string DocNum) and BaseAtCard (supplier doc
--   number) as redundant representations; they are NOT the relationship of
--   record.
--   Timing evidence:
--     PO -> Invoice:  P50 = 0d, P75 = 1d, P90 = 3d (30,010 lines invoiced
--       BEFORE the PO date: backdated PO pattern, magnitude mostly -1..-7d)
--     Invoice -> Receipt: P50 = 1d, P75 = 3d, P90 = 5d (129 negative)
--   Open position (compras abiertas): OPOR.DocStatus = 'O' (33 orders,
--     13 IMP incl. HAINAN ZHONGXIN, THOSCO, FLORAMATIC, USP; 20 LF incl.
--     MATRIPLAST). SAP only distinguishes ORDERED (open PO) vs RECEIVED
--     (OPDN); no customs/in-transit states available.
-- =============================================================================
SELECT
    O."DocEntry"    AS po_docentry,
    O."DocNum"      AS po_docnum,
    O."DocDate"     AS po_docdate,
    O."U_TIPOCOMPRA" AS po_typocompra,
    O."DocCur"      AS po_doccur,
    H."DocEntry"    AS invoice_docentry,
    H."DocNum"      AS invoice_docnum,
    H."DocDate"     AS invoice_docdate,
    D."DocEntry"    AS receipt_docentry,
    D."DocNum"      AS receipt_docnum,
    D."DocDate"     AS receipt_docdate
FROM TELCHI."OPOR" O
LEFT JOIN TELCHI."PCH1" P
    ON P."BaseType" = 22 AND P."BaseEntry" = O."DocEntry"
LEFT JOIN TELCHI."OPCH" H ON H."DocEntry" = P."DocEntry"
LEFT JOIN TELCHI."PDN1" N
    ON (N."BaseType" = 18 AND N."BaseEntry" = H."DocEntry")
    OR (N."BaseType" = 22 AND N."BaseEntry" = O."DocEntry")
LEFT JOIN TELCHI."OPDN" D ON D."DocEntry" = N."DocEntry"
WHERE O."CANCELED" = 'N'

JOIN TELCHI."PCH1" P
    ON P."BaseType" = 22 AND P."BaseEntry" = O."DocEntry"
 | JOIN TELCHI."OPCH" H ON H."DocEntry" = P."DocEntry"
 | JOIN TELCHI."PDN1" N
    ON (N."BaseType" = 18 AND N."BaseEntry" = H."DocEntry")
    OR (N."BaseType" = 22 AND N."BaseEntry" = O."DocEntry")

-- =============================================================================
-- MONTHLY NET SALES — TELCHI_PRODUCT_SEASONALITY_V1
-- =============================================================================
-- Change: TELCHI-SEAS-001
-- Grain: (ItemCode, Year, Month) for sold items.
-- READ ONLY.
-- =============================================================================
-- Canonical demand source:
--   GROSS_UNITS  = SUM(INV1.Quantity) on non-canceled invoices (OINV)
--   RETURNED_UNITS = SUM(RIN1.Quantity) on non-canceled credit notes (ORIN)
--   NET_UNITS    = GROSS - RETURNED (credit notes = returns; DEC-R001 NetSales)
-- Zero-month filling is done in Python (a month with no row means 0, not
-- absence of the month).
-- =============================================================================
SELECT
    y."Year"  AS "Year",
    y."Month" AS "Month",
    y."ItemCode",
    y."GrossQty",
    COALESCE(n."ReturnedQty", 0) AS "ReturnedQty",
    y."GrossQty" - COALESCE(n."ReturnedQty", 0) AS "NetQty"
FROM (
    SELECT YEAR(H."DocDate") AS "Year", MONTH(H."DocDate") AS "Month",
           L."ItemCode", SUM(L."Quantity") AS "GrossQty"
    FROM TELCHI."OINV" H JOIN TELCHI."INV1" L ON L."DocEntry" = H."DocEntry"
    WHERE H."CANCELED" = 'N'
    GROUP BY YEAR(H."DocDate"), MONTH(H."DocDate"), L."ItemCode"
) y
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT YEAR(H."DocDate") AS "Year", MONTH(H."DocDate") AS "Month",
           L."ItemCode", SUM(L."Quantity") AS "ReturnedQty"

-- =============================================================================
-- AS-OF ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE RECONSTRUCTION — TEMPORAL-003
-- =============================================================================
-- Change ID: TEMPORAL-003
-- Motivation: Reconstruct AR position at any historical date.
--   Grain: OINV.DocEntry (one row per invoice)
--   Purpose: Enable aging_as_of(fecha) for temporal analysis
-- =============================================================================
-- Critical: This uses ONLY information available at AS_OF_DATE.
--   - Invoices with DocDate <= AS_OF_DATE
--   - Payments with DocDate <= AS_OF_DATE
--   - Reconciliations with ReconDate <= AS_OF_DATE
--   - Cancellations with CancellationDate <= AS_OF_DATE
-- =============================================================================
-- This prevents data leakage from future events.
-- =============================================================================

WITH as_of_params AS (
    SELECT :as_of_date AS "AS_OF_DATE"
),
-- Invoices active as of date (created before, not canceled before)
active_invoices AS (
    SELECT
        OINV."DocEntry",
        OINV."DocNum",
        OINV."CardCode",
        OINV."SlpCode",
        OINV."DocDate",
        OINV."DocDueDate",
        OINV."DocTotal",
        OINV."DocCur",
        OINV."CANCELED",
        OINV."UpdateDate" AS "CancellationDate",
        CASE
            WHEN OINV."CANCELED" = 'Y'
                 AND OINV."UpdateDate" <= (SELECT "AS_OF_DATE" FROM as_of_params)
            THEN 'CANCELED_AS_OF'
            WHEN OINV."CANCELED" = 'N'
            THEN 'ACTIVE'
            WHEN OINV."CANCELED" = 'Y'
                 AND OINV."UpdateDate" > (SELECT "AS_OF_DATE" FROM as_of_params)
            THEN 'ACTIVE_NOT_YET_CANCELED'
            ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
        END AS "StatusAsOf"
    FROM TELCHI."OINV" AS OINV
    WHERE OINV."DocDate" <= (SELECT "AS_OF_DATE" FROM as_of_params)
),
-- Settlement as of date (reconciliations processed before date)
settlement_as_of AS (
    SELECT
        I."SrcObjAbs" AS "InvoiceDocEntry",
        SUM(I."ReconSum") AS "TotalSettlement"
    FROM TELCHI."ITR1" AS I
    INNER JOIN TELCHI."OITR" AS O ON I."ReconNum" = O."ReconNum"
    WHERE I."SrcObjTyp" = 13
      AND O."Canceled" = 'N'
      AND O."ReconDate" <= (SELECT "AS_OF_DATE" FROM as_of_params)
    GROUP BY I."SrcObjAbs"
),
-- Calculate outstanding as of date
ar_as_of AS (
    SELECT
        AI."DocEntry",
        AI."DocNum",
        AI."CardCode",
        AI."SlpCode",
        AI."DocDate",
        AI."DocDueDate",
        AI."DocTotal",
        AI."DocCur",
        AI."StatusAsOf",
        AI."CancellationDate",
        COALESCE(SA."TotalSettlement", 0) AS "TotalSettlement",
        (AI."DocTotal" - COALESCE(SA."TotalSettlement", 0)) AS "Outstanding",
        CASE
            WHEN AI."DocDueDate" >= (SELECT "AS_OF_DATE" FROM as_of_params) THEN 0
            ELSE DAYS_BETWEEN(AI."DocDueDate", (SELECT "AS_OF_DATE" FROM as_of_params))
        END AS "DaysOverdue",
        (SELECT "AS_OF_DATE" FROM as_of_params) AS "AS_OF_DATE"
    FROM active_invoices AS AI
    LEFT JOIN settlement_as_of AS SA ON AI."DocEntry" = SA."InvoiceDocEntry"
    WHERE AI."StatusAsOf" IN ('ACTIVE', 'ACTIVE_NOT_YET_CANCELED')
)
SELECT
    "DocEntry",
    "DocNum",
    "CardCode",
    "SlpCode",
    "DocDate",
    "DocDueDate",
    "DocTotal",
    "DocCur",
    "StatusAsOf",
    "CancellationDate",
    "TotalSettlement",
    "Outstanding",
    "DaysOverdue",
    "AS_OF_DATE",

    -- Aging bucket
    CASE
        WHEN "Outstanding" <= 0.01 THEN 'SETTLED'
        WHEN "DaysOverdue" = 0 THEN 'NOT_DUE'
        WHEN "DaysOverdue" <= 30 THEN '1-30'
        WHEN "DaysOverdue" <= 60 THEN '31-60'
        WHEN "DaysOverdue" <= 90 THEN '61-90'
        WHEN "DaysOverdue" <= 120 THEN '91-120'
        ELSE '120+'
    END AS "AgingBucket",

    -- Financial status
    CASE
        WHEN "Outstanding" <= -0.01 THEN 'CREDIT_BALANCE'
        WHEN "Outstanding" <= 0.01 THEN 'SETTLED'
        WHEN "DaysOverdue" = 0 THEN 'OPEN_NOT_DUE'
        ELSE 'OVERDUE'
    END AS "FinancialStatus"

FROM ar_as_of
WHERE "Outstanding" > 0.01  -- Only show invoices with positive outstanding
ORDER BY "Outstanding" DESC

        (AI."DocTotal" - COALESCE(SA."TotalSettlement", 0)) AS "Outstanding",
        CASE

        END AS "DaysOverdue",
        (SELECT "AS_OF_DATE" FROM as_of_params) AS "AS_OF_DATE"
    FROM active_invoices AS AI

    "DocCur",
    "StatusAsOf",
    "CancellationDate",
    "TotalSettlement",
    "Outstanding",
    "DaysOverdue",
    "AS_OF_DATE",

    -- Aging bucket
    CASE
        WHEN "Outstanding" <= 0.01 THEN 'SETTLED'
        WHEN "DaysOverdue" = 0 THEN 'NOT_DUE'
        WHEN "DaysOverdue" <= 30 THEN '1-30'
        WHEN "DaysOverdue" <= 60 THEN '31-60'
        WHEN "DaysOverdue" <= 90 THEN '61-90'
        WHEN "DaysOverdue" <= 120 THEN '91-120'
        ELSE '120+'
    END AS "AgingBucket",

    -- Financial status
    CASE
        WHEN "Outstanding" <= -0.01 THEN 'CREDIT_BALANCE'
        WHEN "Outstanding" <= 0.01 THEN 'SETTLED'
        WHEN "DaysOverdue" = 0 THEN 'OPEN_NOT_DUE'

-- =============================================================================
-- INVOICE CANCELLATION LIFECYCLE — TEMPORAL-001
-- =============================================================================
-- Change ID: TEMPORAL-001
-- Motivation: Model the complete lifecycle of invoice cancellations with
--   precise timing derived from SAP fields.
-- Grain: OINV.DocEntry (one row per invoice)
-- Purpose: Enable as-reported, restated, and event views
-- =============================================================================
-- Key Finding: 93.4% of cancellations occur 31-90 days after DocDate.
--   Using only DocDate would miss 93.4% of cancellations.
-- =============================================================================
-- Cancellation Date Derivation:
--   cancellation_date = OINV.UpdateDate (when CANCELED = 'Y')
--   cancellation_time = OINV.UpdateTS (format HHMMSS)
--   cancellation_timestamp = UpdateDate + UpdateTS
-- =============================================================================
-- Y/C Pair Pattern:
--   Y = Original invoice (CANCELED = 'Y')
--   C = Reversal document (CANCELED = 'C')
--   Linked by: CardCode + DocTotal + date proximity (<=7 days)
-- =============================================================================

WITH cancellation_derivation AS (
    SELECT
        OINV."DocEntry",
        OINV."DocNum",
        OINV."CardCode",
        OINV."CardName",
        OINV."SlpCode",
        OINV."DocDate",
        OINV."DocDueDate",
        OINV."DocTotal",
        OINV."DocStatus",
        OINV."CANCELED",
        OINV."DocSubType",
        OINV."TransId",
        OINV."PaidSum",
        OINV."PaidToDate",
        OINV."DocCur",
        OINV."UpdateDate",
        OINV."UpdateTS",

        -- Cancellation derivation
        CASE
            WHEN OINV."CANCELED" = 'Y' THEN OINV."UpdateDate"
            ELSE NULL
        END AS "CancellationDate",

        CASE
            WHEN OINV."CANCELED" = 'Y' THEN OINV."UpdateTS"
            ELSE NULL
        END AS "CancellationTimestamp",

        CASE
            WHEN OINV."CANCELED" = 'Y'
            THEN DAYS_BETWEEN(OINV."DocDate", OINV."UpdateDate")
            ELSE 0
        END AS "DaysToCancellation",

        -- Lifecycle classification
        CASE
            WHEN OINV."CANCELED" = 'N' THEN 'ACTIVE'
            WHEN OINV."CANCELED" = 'Y' THEN 'CANCELED_ORIGINAL'
            WHEN OINV."CANCELED" = 'C' THEN 'CANCELED_REVERSAL'
            ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
        END AS "LifecycleStatus",

        -- Temporal validity
        CASE
            WHEN OINV."CANCELED" = 'N' THEN OINV."DocDate"
            WHEN OINV."CANCELED" = 'Y' THEN OINV."UpdateDate"
            ELSE OINV."DocDate"
        END AS "ValidUntilDate"

    FROM TELCHI."OINV" AS OINV
),
-- Find reversal documents (C) linked to original (Y)
reversal_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        Y."DocEntry" AS "OriginalDocEntry",
        Y."DocNum" AS "OriginalDocNum",
        Y."CardCode",
        Y."DocTotal",
        Y."DocDate" AS "OriginalDocDate",
        Y."UpdateDate" AS "CancellationDate",
        Y."UpdateTS" AS "CancellationTimestamp",
        C."DocEntry" AS "ReversalDocEntry",
        C."DocNum" AS "ReversalDocNum",
        C."DocDate" AS "ReversalDocDate",
        C."TransId" AS "ReversalTransId",
        DAYS_BETWEEN(Y."DocDate", Y."UpdateDate") AS "DaysToCancellation"
    FROM TELCHI."OINV" AS Y
    INNER JOIN TELCHI."OINV" AS C
        ON Y."CardCode" = C."CardCode"
        AND Y."DocTotal" = C."DocTotal"
        AND C."CANCELED" = 'C'
        AND ABS(DAYS_BETWEEN(Y."UpdateDate", C."DocDate")) <= 7
    WHERE Y."CANCELED" = 'Y'
)
SELECT
    CD."DocEntry",
    CD."DocNum",
    CD."CardCode",
    CD."CardName",
    CD."SlpCode",
    CD."DocDate",
    CD."DocDueDate",
    CD."DocTotal",
    CD."DocStatus",
    CD."CANCELED",
    CD."DocSubType",
    CD."TransId",
    CD."PaidSum",
    CD."PaidToDate",
    CD."DocCur",
    CD."UpdateDate",
    CD."UpdateTS",
    CD."CancellationDate",
    CD."CancellationTimestamp",
    CD."DaysToCancellation",
    CD."LifecycleStatus",
    CD."ValidUntilDate",

    -- Reversal pair info
    RP."ReversalDocEntry",
    RP."ReversalDocNum",
    RP."ReversalDocDate",
    RP."ReversalTransId"

FROM cancellation_derivation AS CD
LEFT JOIN reversal_pairs AS RP ON CD."DocEntry" = RP."OriginalDocEntry"
ORDER BY CD."DocDate" DESC, CD."DocEntry"
joins:
JOIN TELCHI."OINV" AS C
        ON Y."CardCode" = C."CardCode"
        AND Y."DocTotal" = C."DocTotal"
        AND C."CANCELED" = 'C'
        AND ABS(DAYS_BETWEEN(Y."UpdateDate", C."DocDate")) <= 7
     | JOIN reversal_pairs AS RP ON CD."DocEntry" = RP."OriginalDocEntry"
filters:
Y."CANCELED" = 'Y'
)
SELECT
    CD."DocEntry",
    CD."DocNum",
    CD."CardCode",
    CD."CardName",
    CD."SlpCode",
    CD."DocDate",
    CD."DocDueDate",
    CD."DocTotal",

    CD."ValidUntilDate",

    -- Reversal pair info
    RP."ReversalDocEntry",
    RP."ReversalDocNum",
    RP."ReversalDocDate",

--   3. In June: F is canceled

        "UpdateTS",
        "TransId"
    FROM TELCHI."OINV"
    WHERE "DocDate" >= '2026-03-01'
      AND "DocDate" < '2026-04-01'

canceled_later AS (

-- Source: srvSyncTelchiSB101.py::makeProduct (inline query for dfItemToWH)
-- Tables: TELCHI.OITT
-- Purpose: Get most recent ToWH (target warehouse) per product from BOM
-- Uses ROW_NUMBER() to pick latest by UpdateDate DESC
-- =============================================================================

SELECT
    "ItemCode",
    "ToWH"
FROM (
    SELECT
        "OITT"."Code" AS "ItemCode",
        "OITT"."UpdateDate",
        "OITT"."ToWH",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY "OITT"."Code"
            ORDER BY "OITT"."UpdateDate" DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM "TELCHI"."OITT" "OITT"
) AS subquery
WHERE rn = 1

sql_text:
WITH ACTIVE AS (
        SELECT "ReconNum" FROM TELCHI."OITR" WHERE "Canceled"='N'
    ), INV AS (
        SELECT I."ReconNum",I."SrcObjAbs" AS "INVOICE_DOCENTRY",SUM(ABS(I."ReconSum")) AS "INV_AMOUNT"
        FROM TELCHI."ITR1" I JOIN ACTIVE A ON A."ReconNum"=I."ReconNum"
        WHERE I."SrcObjTyp"='18' AND I."IsCredit"='C'
        GROUP BY I."ReconNum",I."SrcObjAbs"
    ), TOTALS AS (
        SELECT "ReconNum",SUM("INV_AMOUNT") AS "RECON_INV_TOTAL" FROM INV GROUP BY "ReconNum"
    ), RAW AS (
        SELECT C."ReconNum",
          SUM(CASE WHEN C."SrcObjTyp"='46' THEN CASE WHEN C."IsCredit"='D' THEN ABS(C."ReconSum") ELSE -ABS(C."ReconSum") END ELSE 0 END) AS "PAYMENT_MEMBER",
          SUM(CASE WHEN C."SrcObjTyp"='19' THEN CASE WHEN C."IsCredit"='D' THEN ABS(C."ReconSum") ELSE -ABS(C."ReconSum") END ELSE 0 END) AS "CREDIT_MEMBER",
          SUM(CASE WHEN C."SrcObjTyp" IN ('25','204') THEN CASE WHEN C."IsCredit"='D' THEN ABS(C."ReconSum") ELSE -ABS(C."ReconSum") END ELSE 0 END) AS "ADVANCE_MEMBER",
          SUM(CASE WHEN C."SrcObjTyp"='30' THEN CASE WHEN C."IsCredit"='D' THEN ABS(C."ReconSum") ELSE -ABS(C."ReconSum") END ELSE 0 END) AS "JOURNAL_MEMBER",
          COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN C."SrcObjTyp"='46' AND C."IsCredit"='D' THEN C."SrcObjAbs" END) AS "PAYMENT_COUNT",
          COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN C."SrcObjTyp"='19' AND C."IsCredit"='D' THEN C."SrcObjAbs" END) AS "CREDIT_COUNT",
          COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN C."SrcObjTyp" IN ('25','204') AND C."IsCredit"='D' THEN C."SrcObjAbs" END) AS "ADVANCE_COUNT",
          COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN C."SrcObjTyp"='30' THEN C."TransId" END) AS "JOURNAL_COUNT"
        FROM TELCHI."ITR1" C JOIN ACTIVE A ON A."ReconNum"=C."ReconNum"
        WHERE C."SrcObjTyp" NOT IN ('18','321')
        GROUP BY C."ReconNum"
    ), COMP AS (
        SELECT I."ReconNum",I."INVOICE_DOCENTRY",I."INV_AMOUNT",T."RECON_INV_TOTAL",
          COALESCE(R."PAYMENT_MEMBER",0) AS "PAYMENT_MEMBER",COALESCE(R."CREDIT_MEMBER",0) AS "CREDIT_MEMBER",COALESCE(R."ADVANCE_MEMBER",0) AS "ADVANCE_MEMBER",COALESCE(R."JOURNAL_MEMBER",0) AS "JOURNAL_MEMBER",
          T."RECON_INV_TOTAL"-COALESCE(R."PAYMENT_MEMBER",0)-COALESCE(R."CREDIT_MEMBER",0)-COALESCE(R."ADVANCE_MEMBER",0)-COALESCE(R."JOURNAL_MEMBER",0) AS "OTHER_MEMBER",
          COALESCE(R."PAYMENT_COUNT",0) AS "PAYMENT_COUNT",COALESCE(R."CREDIT_COUNT",0) AS "CREDIT_COUNT",COALESCE(R."ADVANCE_COUNT",0) AS "ADVANCE_COUNT",COALESCE(R."JOURNAL_COUNT",0) AS "JOURNAL_COUNT"
        FROM INV I JOIN TOTALS T ON T."ReconNum"=I."ReconNum" LEFT JOIN RAW R ON R."ReconNum"=I."ReconNum"

CREATE TEMP TABLE summary_by_modality AS
WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT payment_classification AS modality,
         count(*) AS documents,
         sum(net_amount) AS net_amount
  FROM document_detail
  GROUP BY payment_classification
), totals AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS documents, sum(net_amount) AS net_amount FROM document_detail
), categories(modality, sort_order) AS (
  VALUES ('CONTADO_CONFIRMED', 1), ('CREDIT_CONFIRMED', 2),
         ('OTHER_PAYMENT_MODE', 3), ('NOT_DETERMINABLE', 4)
)
SELECT c.modality,
       coalesce(g.documents, 0) AS documents,
       CASE WHEN t.documents = 0 THEN 0 ELSE round(100.0 * coalesce(g.documents, 0) / t.documents, 4) END AS document_percent,
       coalesce(g.net_amount, 0::DECIMAL(38,6)) AS net_amount,
       CASE WHEN t.net_amount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE round(100.0 * coalesce(g.net_amount, 0) / t.net_amount, 4) END AS net_amount_percent
FROM categories c
LEFT JOIN grouped g USING(modality)
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY c.sort_order;

    ),
    invoice_settlement AS (
        SELECT
            I."SrcObjAbs" AS "InvoiceDocEntry",
            SUM(I."ReconSum") AS "TotalSettlement",
            COUNT(DISTINCT I."ReconNum") AS "ReconCount"
        FROM TELCHI."ITR1" AS I
        INNER JOIN TELCHI."OITR" AS O ON I."ReconNum" = O."ReconNum"
        WHERE I."SrcObjTyp" = 13 AND O."Canceled" = 'N'
        GROUP BY I."SrcObjAbs"

    SELECT
        OINV."DocEntry",
        OINV."DocNum",
        OINV."CardCode",
        OINV."SlpCode",
        OINV."DocDate",
        OINV."DocDueDate",
        OINV."DocTotal",
        OINV."DocCur",
        OINV."DocStatus",
        OINV."CANCELED",

        COALESCE(IS2."ReconCount", 0) AS "ReconCount",
        (OINV."DocTotal" - COALESCE(IS2."TotalSettlement", 0)) AS "Outstanding",
        CASE
            WHEN OINV."DocDueDate" >= (SELECT "AS_OF_DATE" FROM as_of) THEN 0
            ELSE DAYS_BETWEEN(OINV."DocDueDate", (SELECT "AS_OF_DATE" FROM as_of))
        END AS "DaysOverdue",
        (SELECT "AS_OF_DATE" FROM as_of) AS "AS_OF_DATE"
    FROM TELCHI."OINV"
    LEFT JOIN invoice_settlement AS IS2 ON OINV."DocEntry" = IS2."InvoiceDocEntry"
    WHERE OINV."CANCELED" = 'N' AND OINV."DocStatus" = 'O'

WITH raw AS (
        SELECT ForecastId, ForecastCode, ForecastName,
               CAST(StartDate AS DATE) AS HeaderStart,
               CAST(EndDate AS DATE) AS HeaderEnd,
               FormView, ItemCode, Warehouse,
               CAST(Period AS DATE) AS Period,
               CAST(Quantity AS DOUBLE) AS Quantity
        FROM read_parquet('{sql_path(forecast_path)}')
    ), defs AS (
        SELECT ForecastId, ForecastCode, ForecastName, HeaderStart, HeaderEnd,
               FormView, MIN(Period) AS MinPeriod, MAX(Period) AS MaxPeriod
        FROM raw GROUP BY ALL
    ), agg AS (
        SELECT r.ForecastId, r.ItemCode, r.Warehouse,
               d.ForecastCode, d.ForecastName, d.HeaderStart, d.HeaderEnd,
               d.FormView, d.MinPeriod, d.MaxPeriod,
               SUM(r.Quantity) AS ForecastQty,
               COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('month', r.Period)) AS ComparableMonths
        FROM raw r JOIN defs d USING (ForecastId)
        GROUP BY ALL
    ), ranked AS (
        SELECT ForecastId, ItemCode, Warehouse, ForecastCode, ForecastName,
               HeaderStart, HeaderEnd, FormView, MinPeriod, MaxPeriod,
               ForecastQty, ComparableMonths,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY ItemCode, Warehouse
                   ORDER BY CASE
                       WHEN HeaderStart <= DATE '{snap}' AND HeaderEnd >= DATE '{snap}' THEN 0
                       WHEN HeaderStart > DATE '{snap}' THEN 1
                       ELSE 2 END,
                       HeaderEnd DESC, ForecastId DESC
               ) AS selection_rank
        FROM agg
    )
    SELECT ForecastId, ItemCode, Warehouse, ForecastCode, ForecastName,
           HeaderStart, HeaderEnd, FormView, MinPeriod, MaxPeriod,
           ForecastQty, ComparableMonths
    FROM ranked WHERE selection_rank = 1

WITH base AS (
            SELECT p.ItemCode, i.Description, i.Active,
                   i.MRPIncluded, i.ProcurementMethod, p.Warehouse,
                   p.PlanningIncludedFlag, p.WarehouseName, i.BOMExists,
                   s.ForecastId, s.ForecastCode, s.ForecastName,
                   s.HeaderStart, s.HeaderEnd, s.MinPeriod, s.MaxPeriod,
                   s.ForecastQty, s.ComparableMonths,
                   l.GapClassification, l.LeadTimeConfidence, l.SAPLeadTime
            FROM pairs p JOIN items i USING (ItemCode)
            LEFT JOIN selected_forecast s USING (ItemCode, Warehouse)
            LEFT JOIN lead l USING (ItemCode)
        ), classified AS (
            SELECT *,
              CASE WHEN ForecastId IS NULL THEN 'NO_FORECAST'
                   WHEN ForecastQty = 0 THEN 'ZERO_FORECAST'
                   WHEN MaxPeriod < DATE '{snapshot.isoformat()}' THEN 'EXPIRED_FORECAST'
                   WHEN MinPeriod > DATE '{snapshot.isoformat()}' THEN 'FUTURE_FORECAST'
                   WHEN MinPeriod < DATE '{month_start}' AND MaxPeriod > DATE '{snapshot.isoformat()}' THEN 'MIXED_FORECAST'
                   ELSE 'CURRENT_FORECAST' END AS ForecastStatus,
              CASE WHEN ForecastId IS NULL THEN NULL
                   ELSE GREATEST(0, DATE_DIFF('day', DATE '{snapshot.isoformat()}', MaxPeriod)) END AS FutureCoverageDays,
              CASE WHEN ForecastId IS NULL THEN NULL
                   ELSE ROUND(GREATEST(0, DATE_DIFF('day', DATE '{snapshot.isoformat()}', MaxPeriod)) / 30.4375, 2) END AS FutureCoverageMonths,
              CASE WHEN ForecastId IS NULL THEN NULL
                   ELSE CAST(MinPeriod AS VARCHAR) || '..' || CAST(MaxPeriod AS VARCHAR) END AS ForecastPeriod,
              CASE WHEN ForecastId IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'MRP_USAGE_UNKNOWN' END AS UsageStatus,
              CASE WHEN ForecastId IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS GapType,
              CASE WHEN ForecastId IS NULL THEN 'LOW_CONFIDENCE' ELSE 'LOW_CONFIDENCE' END AS Confidence
            FROM base
        )
        SELECT ItemCode, Description, Active, MRPIncluded, ProcurementMethod, Warehouse,
               ForecastCode, ForecastName,
               CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS DemandClass,
               CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS Observed12M, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS Observed6M,

                       d.source_system||'|'||d.source_table||'|'||d.doc_entry document_id,

                       d.sales_channel_code,coalesce(d.sales_channel_name,'UNKNOWN') channel,
                       d.slp_code,coalesce(sp.name,'UNKNOWN') salesperson,
                       d.user_sign,coalesce(u.name,'UNKNOWN') operator_name,
                       l.line_num,l.item_code,p.product_name,pbt.product_business_type,
                       pbt.status classification_status,pbt.classification_basis,pbt.classification_source,

WITH classified AS (
  SELECT p.item_code, p.canonical_product_id, p.product_name, p.canonical_name,
         p.source_system, p.source_native_id, pf.code AS portfolio_family,
         pf.source AS classification_source, pf.confidence, pf.status
  FROM read_parquet('{products}') p
  JOIN read_parquet('{relation}') r ON r.canonical_product_id = p.canonical_product_id
  JOIN read_parquet('{families}') pf ON pf.portfolio_family_id = r.portfolio_family_id
  WHERE pf.code = 'LITEL'
), sales AS (
  SELECT l.item_code, COUNT(*) AS sales_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT h.doc_entry) AS sales_documents,
         SUM(TRY_CAST(l.quantity AS DECIMAL(38,10))) AS sales_quantity,
         COUNT(DISTINCT l.whs_code) AS sales_warehouses,
         COUNT(DISTINCT h.card_code) AS sales_customers,
         COUNT(DISTINCT SUBSTR(h.doc_date, 1, 7)) AS active_months
  FROM telchi.atomic.sales_document h
  JOIN telchi.atomic.sales_line l ON l.doc_entry = h.doc_entry
  WHERE h.doc_date >= '2026-01-01' AND h.doc_date < '2026-09-16'
  GROUP BY l.item_code
), moves AS (
  SELECT item_code, COUNT(*) AS movement_rows,
         COUNT(DISTINCT warehouse) AS movement_warehouses,
         COUNT(DISTINCT trans_type) AS movement_trans_types,
         SUM(TRY_CAST(in_qty AS DECIMAL(38,10))) AS total_in_qty,
         SUM(TRY_CAST(out_qty AS DECIMAL(38,10))) AS total_out_qty
  FROM telchi.atomic.inventory_movement
  WHERE doc_date >= '2026-01-01' AND doc_date < '2026-09-16'
  GROUP BY item_code
), ranked AS (
  SELECT c.*, s.sales_lines, s.sales_documents, s.sales_quantity,
         s.sales_warehouses, s.sales_customers, s.active_months,
         m.movement_rows, m.movement_warehouses, m.movement_trans_types,
         m.total_in_qty, m.total_out_qty,
         (s.sales_lines + s.sales_warehouses * 100 + COALESCE(m.movement_warehouses,0) * 50 + COALESCE(m.movement_trans_types,0) * 200 + s.active_months * 100 + LEAST(s.sales_customers, 2000)) AS representativeness_score,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY c.item_code ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.source_system = 'SAP_HANA' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
           c.canonical_product_id
         ) AS source_rank
  FROM classified c JOIN sales s ON s.item_code = c.item_code
  LEFT JOIN moves m ON m.item_code = c.item_code
)

WHERE source_rank = 1 AND sales_lines BETWEEN 3000 AND 10000

      I."LineNum" AS "source_line", R."LineNum" AS "order_line", I."ItemCode" AS "item_code",

    H."CANCELED" AS "current_canceled", H."DocStatus" AS "order_status",
    H."CreateDate" AS "order_create_date", H."CreateTS" AS "order_create_ts",

    H."UserSign" AS "user_sign", H."U_ORIGIN" AS "channel",
    H."U_OSLP_ID" AS "route_id",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN R."ItemCode" LIKE 'L%' THEN 1 END) AS "l_line_count",
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN R."ItemCode" LIKE 'L%' THEN R."ItemCode" END)
        AS "l_item_count",

         ELSE 'MULTIPLE' END AS "warehouse"

WITH O AS ({frozen_order_cte}), S AS ({SOURCE_CTE}), E AS (
  SELECT S."order_entry", S."source_route", S."source_entry",
         S."source_line", S."item_code", S."warehouse" AS "document_warehouse",
         M."Warehouse" AS "movement_warehouse", SUM(M."OutQty") AS "out_qty",
         MIN(S."source_create_date") AS "source_create_date",
         MIN(S."source_create_ts") AS "source_create_ts"
  FROM S
  INNER JOIN "TELCHI"."OINM" M
    ON M."TransType"=S."source_type"
   AND M."CreatedBy"=S."source_entry"
   AND M."DocLineNum"=S."source_line"
   AND M."ItemCode"=S."item_code"
   AND M."Warehouse"=S."warehouse"
   AND M."OutQty">0

           S."source_line", S."item_code", S."warehouse", M."Warehouse"
)

       COUNT(DISTINCT "source_entry") AS "source_documents",

       MIN("source_create_date") AS "min_source_date",
       MAX("source_create_date") AS "max_source_date"
FROM E
GROUP BY "movement_warehouse"
ORDER BY "orders" DESC

CREATE TABLE telchi.business.receivable_settlement_status AS
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT participant_object_abs AS document_id,
         try_cast(reconciliation_date AS DATE) AS effect_date,
         sum(CASE WHEN is_credit='D' THEN try_cast(reconciled_amount AS DECIMAL(38,6)) ELSE 0 END) AS reduction_amount,
         sum(CASE WHEN is_credit='D' THEN try_cast(reconciled_amount_system AS DECIMAL(38,6)) ELSE 0 END) AS reduction_system_amount
  FROM telchi.atomic.reconciliation_participant
  WHERE participant_object_type='13'
  GROUP BY 1,2
), running AS (
  SELECT document_id,effect_date,reduction_amount,reduction_system_amount,
         sum(reduction_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY document_id ORDER BY effect_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_reduction,
         sum(reduction_system_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY document_id ORDER BY effect_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_reduction_system
  FROM daily
), effects AS (
  SELECT r.document_id,
         sum(r.reduction_amount) AS economic_reduction_amount,
         sum(r.reduction_system_amount) AS economic_reduction_system_amount,
         min(CASE WHEN r.cumulative_reduction >= try_cast(d.document_total AS DECIMAL(38,6))-.01 THEN r.effect_date END) AS fully_settled_date
  FROM running r JOIN telchi.atomic.receivable_document d ON d.source_doc_entry=r.document_id
  GROUP BY r.document_id
), typed AS (
  SELECT p.participant_object_abs AS document_id,
         sum(CASE WHEN kinds.has_payment AND NOT kinds.has_credit THEN try_cast(p.reconciled_amount AS DECIMAL(38,6)) ELSE 0 END) AS payment_settlement_effect,
         sum(CASE WHEN kinds.has_credit AND NOT kinds.has_payment THEN try_cast(p.reconciled_amount AS DECIMAL(38,6)) ELSE 0 END) AS credit_memo_settlement_effect,
         sum(CASE WHEN NOT kinds.has_payment AND NOT kinds.has_credit THEN try_cast(p.reconciled_amount AS DECIMAL(38,6)) ELSE 0 END) AS internal_reconciliation_effect,
         sum(CASE WHEN kinds.has_payment AND kinds.has_credit THEN try_cast(p.reconciled_amount AS DECIMAL(38,6)) ELSE 0 END) AS multi_source_reconciliation_effect
  FROM telchi.atomic.reconciliation_participant p
  JOIN (SELECT reconciliation_id,
               bool_or(participant_object_type='24') AS has_payment,
               bool_or(participant_object_type='14') AS has_credit
        FROM telchi.atomic.reconciliation_participant GROUP BY 1) kinds USING (reconciliation_id)
  WHERE p.participant_object_type='13' AND p.is_credit='D'
  GROUP BY 1
), base AS (
  SELECT d.*, coalesce(e.economic_reduction_amount,0::DECIMAL(38,6)) AS reduction,
         coalesce(e.economic_reduction_system_amount,0::DECIMAL(38,6)) AS reduction_system,
         e.fully_settled_date,
         greatest(0::DECIMAL(38,6),try_cast(d.document_total AS DECIMAL(38,6))-coalesce(e.economic_reduction_amount,0::DECIMAL(38,6))) AS open_amount,
         greatest(0::DECIMAL(38,6),try_cast(d.document_total_system AS DECIMAL(38,6))-coalesce(e.economic_reduction_system_amount,0::DECIMAL(38,6))) AS open_system_amount
  FROM telchi.atomic.receivable_document d LEFT JOIN effects e ON e.document_id=d.source_doc_entry
)

       try_cast(document_date AS DATE) AS document_date,try_cast(due_date AS DATE) AS due_date,

WITH components AS (
  SELECT payment_doc_entry,method_code,
         sum(try_cast(component_amount AS DECIMAL(38,6))) AS source_component_amount,
         sum(try_cast(component_amount_foreign AS DECIMAL(38,6))) AS source_component_foreign,
         sum(try_cast(component_amount_system AS DECIMAL(38,6))) AS source_component_system,
         count(*) AS source_component_rows
  FROM telchi.atomic.payment_method_component GROUP BY 1,2
), known AS (
  SELECT p.source_doc_entry AS payment_id,try_cast(p.payment_date AS DATE) AS payment_date,p.customer_code,p.currency,
         c.method_code AS collection_method,c.source_component_amount,c.source_component_foreign,c.source_component_system,c.source_component_rows,

         CASE WHEN p.cancelled IN ('Y','C') THEN 0::DECIMAL(38,6) ELSE c.source_component_system END AS effective_amount_system
  FROM telchi.atomic.collection_payment p JOIN components c ON c.payment_doc_entry=p.source_doc_entry

CREATE TEMP VIEW scoped_sales AS
SELECT d.source_system,
       d.source_table,
       d.doc_entry,
       d.doc_num,
       CAST(d.doc_date AS DATE) AS document_date,
       CAST(d.doc_due_date AS DATE) AS due_date,
       d.doc_status,
       d.card_code,
       d.currency AS document_currency,
       d.sales_channel_code,
       d.sales_channel_name,
       d.slp_code AS header_seller_code,
       l.line_num,
       l.item_code,
       l.whs_code,
       try_cast(l.quantity AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS quantity,
       try_cast(l.line_total AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS gross_amount,
       coalesce(l.attributed_slp_code, l.slp_code, d.slp_code) AS seller_code
FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 952)) d
JOIN (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_line" AT (VERSION => 952)) l
  ON l.source_system = d.source_system
 AND l.doc_entry = d.doc_entry
JOIN product_business_type p
  ON p.ItemCode = l.item_code
 AND p.product_business_type = 'RAW_MATERIAL'
WHERE d.card_code = 'CG2A'
  AND coalesce(d.canceled, 'N') <> 'Y'
  AND CAST(d.doc_date AS DATE) >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND CAST(d.doc_date AS DATE) < DATE '2027-01-01';

CREATE TEMP VIEW scoped_credits AS
SELECT d.source_system,
       d.source_table,
       d.doc_entry AS credit_doc_entry,
       d.doc_num AS credit_doc_num,
       CAST(d.doc_date AS DATE) AS credit_date,
       l.line_num AS credit_line_num,
       l.item_code,
       try_cast(l.quantity AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS credit_quantity,
       try_cast(l.line_total AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS credit_amount,
       l.base_type,
       l.base_entry,
       l.base_line
FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."credit_memo_document" AT (VERSION => 952)) d
JOIN (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."credit_memo_line" AT (VERSION => 952)) l
  ON l.source_system = d.source_system
 AND l.doc_entry = d.doc_entry
JOIN product_business_type p
  ON p.ItemCode = l.item_code
 AND p.product_business_type = 'RAW_MATERIAL'
WHERE d.card_code = 'CG2A'
  AND coalesce(d.canceled, 'N') <> 'Y'
  AND CAST(d.doc_date AS DATE) >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND CAST(d.doc_date AS DATE) < DATE '2027-01-01';

CREATE TEMP VIEW credit_by_sales_line AS
SELECT s.source_system,
       s.doc_entry,
       s.line_num,
       sum(c.credit_amount) AS credit_amount,
       sum(c.credit_quantity) AS credit_quantity,
       string_agg(DISTINCT CAST(c.credit_doc_entry AS VARCHAR), ',' ORDER BY CAST(c.credit_doc_entry AS VARCHAR)) AS credit_doc_entries,
       string_agg(DISTINCT CAST(c.credit_doc_num AS VARCHAR), ',' ORDER BY CAST(c.credit_doc_num AS VARCHAR)) AS credit_doc_nums,
       max(c.credit_date) AS latest_credit_date
FROM scoped_sales s
JOIN scoped_credits c
  ON c.source_system = s.source_system
 AND try_cast(c.base_type AS INTEGER) = 13
 AND CAST(c.base_entry AS VARCHAR) = CAST(s.doc_entry AS VARCHAR)
 AND CAST(c.base_line AS VARCHAR) = CAST(s.line_num AS VARCHAR)
 AND c.item_code = s.item_code
GROUP BY s.source_system, s.doc_entry, s.line_num;

CREATE TEMP TABLE line_detail AS
SELECT s.source_system || '|' || s.source_table || '|' || CAST(s.doc_entry AS VARCHAR) AS document_id,
       s.source_system,
       s.source_table,
       s.doc_entry,
       s.doc_num,
       s.document_date,
       s.due_date,
       s.doc_status,
       s.card_code,
       s.line_num,
       s.item_code,
       p.product_name,
       'RAW_MATERIAL' AS product_business_class,
       s.quantity,
       coalesce(iu.uom, 'UNAVAILABLE') AS uom,
       s.document_currency AS currency,
       s.gross_amount,
       coalesce(c.credit_amount, 0::DECIMAL(38,6)) AS credit_memo_amount,
       s.gross_amount - coalesce(c.credit_amount, 0::DECIMAL(38,6)) AS net_amount,
       c.credit_doc_entries,
       c.credit_doc_nums,
       c.latest_credit_date,
       s.seller_code,
       coalesce(sp.name, 'UNKNOWN') AS seller_name,
       s.whs_code AS warehouse,
       coalesce(wl.business_location_code, 'UNKNOWN') AS business_location,
       s.sales_channel_code,
       s.sales_channel_name
FROM scoped_sales s
LEFT JOIN credit_by_sales_line c
  ON c.source_system = s.source_system
 AND c.doc_entry = s.doc_entry
 AND c.line_num = s.line_num
LEFT JOIN products p ON p.item_code = s.item_code
LEFT JOIN item_uom iu ON iu.ItemCode = s.item_code
LEFT JOIN salespersons sp ON sp.code = s.seller_code
LEFT JOIN warehouse_location wl
  ON wl.warehouse_code = s.whs_code
 AND wl.source_system = 'SAP_HANA';

CREATE TEMP TABLE document_detail AS
SELECT document_id,
       any_value(source_system) AS source_system,
       any_value(source_table) AS source_table,
       any_value(doc_entry) AS doc_entry,
       any_value(doc_num) AS doc_num,
       any_value(document_date) AS document_date,
       any_value(due_date) AS due_date,
       any_value(doc_status) AS document_status,
       any_value(card_code) AS card_code,
       string_agg(DISTINCT item_code, ',' ORDER BY item_code) AS item_codes,
       string_agg(DISTINCT coalesce(product_name, item_code), ' | ' ORDER BY coalesce(product_name, item_code)) AS products,
       string_agg(DISTINCT uom, ',' ORDER BY uom) AS units_of_measure,
       sum(quantity) AS raw_material_quantity_unconverted,
       any_value(currency) AS currency,
       sum(gross_amount) AS gross_amount,
       sum(credit_memo_amount) AS associated_credit_memo_amount,
       sum(net_amount) AS net_amount,
       string_agg(DISTINCT credit_doc_entries, ',' ORDER BY credit_doc_entries)
         FILTER (WHERE credit_doc_entries IS NOT NULL) AS associated_credit_doc_entries,
       max(latest_credit_date) AS latest_credit_date,
       string_agg(DISTINCT CAST(seller_code AS VARCHAR), ',' ORDER BY CAST(seller_code AS VARCHAR)) AS seller_codes,
       string_agg(DISTINCT seller_name, ' | ' ORDER BY seller_name) AS sellers,
       string_agg(DISTINCT warehouse, ',' ORDER BY warehouse) AS warehouses,
       string_agg(DISTINCT business_location, ',' ORDER BY business_location) AS business_locations,
       string_agg(DISTINCT coalesce(sales_channel_name, sales_channel_code, 'UNKNOWN'), ',' ORDER BY coalesce(sales_channel_name, sales_channel_code, 'UNKNOWN')) AS sales_channels,
       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS payment_term_documental,
       CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS payment_date,
       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS payment_means,
       CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS paid_amount,
       CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS open_balance,
       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS reconciliation_id,
       CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS days_sale_to_payment,
       'NOT_DETERMINABLE' AS payment_classification,
       'Foundation CURRENT has sales and linked credit-note evidence, but no transactional payment, receipt, reconciliation, open-balance, settlement-date or payment-means dataset. Due date and document status do not prove effective payment.' AS classification_reason
FROM line_detail
GROUP BY document_id;

CREATE TEMP TABLE summary_by_modality AS
WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT payment_classification AS modality,
         count(*) AS documents,
         sum(net_amount) AS net_amount
  FROM document_detail
  GROUP BY payment_classification
), totals AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS documents, sum(net_amount) AS net_amount FROM document_detail
), categories(modality, sort_order) AS (
  VALUES ('CONTADO_CONFIRMED', 1), ('CREDIT_CONFIRMED', 2),
         ('OTHER_PAYMENT_MODE', 3), ('NOT_DETERMINABLE', 4)
)
SELECT c.modality,
       coalesce(g.documents, 0) AS documents,
       CASE WHEN t.documents = 0 THEN 0 ELSE round(100.0 * coalesce(g.documents, 0) / t.documents, 4) END AS document_percent,
       coalesce(g.net_amount, 0::DECIMAL(38,6)) AS net_amount,
       CASE WHEN t.net_amount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE round(100.0 * coalesce(g.net_amount, 0) / t.net_amount, 4) END AS net_amount_percent
FROM categories c
LEFT JOIN grouped g USING(modality)
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY c.sort_order;
